# Fourier table

Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) of a series of temperatures with resulting
frequencies, periods, coefficients and powers in a single table.

## Usage

``` r
fft_tab(s, t, period = TRUE, power = TRUE)
```

## Arguments

- s:

  num. Sampled temperatures at constant interval.

- t:

  int. Time window, \\t=N\Delta t\\ where \\\Delta t\\ is the sampling
  interval.

- period:

  bool. To include period or not, default TRUE.

- power:

  bool. To include power or not, default TRUE.

## Value

A table with:

- \\f\\ the harmonics frequencies \\1/t,\ldots \ell/t\\

- \\p\\ the harmonics periods

- \\c\\ the Fourier coefficients of \\s\\ of length \\\ell\\, whose
  coefficients are \\c\_{0},c\_{1},\ldots,c\_{\ell-1}\\

- \\P\\ array of powers, \\P\[n\] = \|c\_{n}\|\\ for
  \\n=1,\ldots,\ell-1\\

## Examples

``` r
fft_tab(hobo$t_hobo[1:(24 * 5)], 24 * 5)
```
